verify_intro: Confirm this address to finish changing the email used by your {application_name} account.
verify_ignore: If you didn’t request this change, do not verify it.
requested_intro: Someone requested a new email address for your account. Your current address remains active until the new address is verified.
requested_action: If this wasn’t you, cancel the request and secure your account immediately.
changed_intro: The email address used to sign in to your {application_name} account has changed. All existing sessions and password-reset links were revoked.
changed_action: If this wasn’t you, secure your account immediately and contact an administrator.
cancelled_intro: The pending email address change was cancelled. Your existing address remains active.
